title: Cannot scroll through Digital Clock's Calendar pages with a single mouse scroll step
line: One step of the mouse wheel over the clock's calendar now moves exactly one month (or year or decade) instead of nudging and snapping back.
explanation: MonthView.qml has a WheelHandler that changes page every 15 degrees of rotation, but it only accepted PointerDevice.Mouse. QtWayland registers every pointer as a touchpad, so the handler never ran and the wheel event fell through to the SwipeView's flicking, which needs a long movement and otherwise snaps back. The handler now accepts touchpads too; discrete wheel events (no scroll phase) keep the 15 degree step, while real touchpad swipes (with scroll phases) need 90 degrees (about 60 px) per page and reset at the start and end of each gesture so a light touch doesn't skip months.

commits.message:
components/calendar: Change the month with every wheel step

The wheel handler only accepted mice, but QtWayland reports all pointers
as touchpads, so a wheel step fell through to the swipe view and snapped
back. Accept touchpads too, with a longer step for touchpad swipes.

BUG: 479972

media.caption: Master: after one wheel notch down, then one up, then one more up, the calendar is still on November each time.
Fixed: the same three notches go to December, back to November, then October.
Master: the three single wheel notches recorded; the month never changes.
Fixed: each single wheel notch changes the month by one.
